The [rendered report](preview.pdf) on this site is built by the format as the site is published.

An option belongs in one of three places.

- A format option goes under `format: mcanouil-html:`, `mcanouil-typst:`, or `mcanouil-revealjs:`.
- A document option goes under `extensions: mcanouil:`.
- A block attribute goes on the element itself.

## A website

```yaml
project:
  type: mcanouil
```

The project type supplies a branded navbar, a page footer, and a favicon, and it sets `mcanouil-html` as the default format, so a site needs nothing else to be branded.

It also supplies a value for several document options.
A standalone document has no project type, so some of its options resolve differently, which [HTML format](examples/html-format.qmd#where-a-default-comes-from) sets out.
